brief: The holy women of the Old Testament were examples of many things. Some were victims, like Jephthah’s daughter. Some were leaders and prophets, like Huldah, the consultant to King Josiah, Deborah among the judges, and Miriam in the Exodus. In Egypt, Moses and the whole Hebrew people were preserved through the independent actions of women. Women figure also in the period after the exile. In the patriarchal literature of a patriarchal society, however, there are many others whose parts in God’s purposes are not recorded.
